headline: Hangyu Flying Trapeze
title: Hangyu | Float Up While Gliding | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want to glide upward instead of falling? Bring Hangyu. Its partner skill, Flying Trapeze, boosts your equipped glider so you slowly rise while gliding. At base it works Transporting at level two, plus Handiwork and Gathering at level one. It is a small Ground Pal that is easy to carry around. Do you glide with Hangyu? Comment below!
description: Hangyu in Palworld 1.0: Flying Trapeze lets you rise while gliding, plus Transporting level two.
